Both bounds give dimension1001−860=141. originality.rationale: A decisive earlier theorem and an exact earlier published numerical instance already establish the entire claimed dimension. Laface–Postinghel–Santana Sánchez (arXiv:2205.04184, first posted May 2022; LAA 657, 2023) explicitly prove the n+3-point conjecture for points on a rational normal curve, which includes seven general points of P4; here k_C=2 and all m_i=6>=k_C. Brambilla–Postinghel (2025), Example 3.9, explicitly states projective dimension 140 for L_{4,10}(6^7), equivalent to this vector dimension 141. The package cites only the older 2015 conjectural source and incorrectly treats k_C>1 as an unsolved exception. Distinct certificate/proof presentation does not make the final mathematical dimension claim original.
residual_risks: No residual uncertainty on coverage of the exact stated dimension: 2025 survey expressly reproduces it. Only the possible novelty of an independent rank certificate would require a separately motivated new claim, which is not the final theorem assessed.
